integrated longitudinal consequences for all four players under declared inheritance rules with censoring stated
all-channel per-attempt provenance with channel availability declared per configured agent
normative contract that permits public deception, so social findings are proposition/channel/exposure/response chronologies, not a misalignment class
publicly replayable artifacts (events, actions, decisions, prompts, state) plus verifier scripts
uncapped games ending by bankruptcy with a liquidation phase (absent by rule in AgentMonopoly)

first legal menus, deterministic engine or replay (AgentMonopoly, DECE)
first state-checked speech or follow-through analysis (Arena paper)
generic harness rank-reversal law (DECE matched studies are game-specific)
